rendered: The clinical sepsis serum samples came from patients with septic patients with confirmed E. coli infection, septic patients with confirmed E. faecium infection[1]. In other words, the infections were caused by E. coli[2] and E. faecium[3]. The control group was healthy volunteers serving as the control[4]. The sensor array's LDA plot separated all of these serum groups into distinct clusters that did not overlap (Fig. 5[5], panel c).[6]
